name: Ruling
description: A ruling pen at three settings — coarse, medium and fine, one setting to a cell.

code.style: --rule: ( --gap: @pick(12%, 18%, 26%); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 5%, transparent 5% @var(--gap)); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 5%, transparent 5% @var(--gap)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
